ROW 3318 | ENC E-88213 | PT_NAME: FROST, SKY W | NOTE_TYPE: LETTER TO SCHOOL
Cedar Hollow Pediatrics Letter date: 01/10/2069
To whom it may concern at Willowmere Elementary (attn Ms. Storey, classroom teacher, and school nurse Dawn Sumner)
RE: Sky Frost, 5 y.o., kindergarten
- Sky was seen in the ED on 12/19/2068 for a concusion (no loss of consciousness) after a fall from the climbing frame, and followed up here. - Still recovering. She may return to class for half days, building up as tolerated - No recess play on the climbing frame, no PE, no ball games until I clear her in writing - Screens and bright light: let her rest her eyes when she asks, a quiet corner is fine. Dont push her to "catch up" on worksheets - Watch for: headache that gets worse, vomiting, being unusually sleepy or cranky, double vision. If any of these - call Hope Frost (mom) and send her to us or the ED - Mom's cell is on the school card. Dad is Royal Adeyemi, different surname, please dont mix them up in the office system - Sky is a bright kid and the sky is not falling, she will be back to full activity in a few weeks, next review early March
Thanks for your help. Sincerly,
Will Page, MD Cedar Hollow Pediatrics Electronically signed 01/10/2069 16:41 by wpage
